correctness.rationale: Fekete superadditivity gives γ for each fixed d. Greedy matching of an arbitrary target has an exact independent geometric waiting-time decomposition and Laplace product. A union bound over all q^ℓ targets produces a valid finite-rate bound. At t=(log d)/(dΔ), nonmaximal-letter terms sum to O(1/d), and the geometric Laplace exponent second-order expansion gives the coefficient. The LLN supplies the p1 lower baseline. Every limit and positivity condition is explicit; finite enumeration checks only the finite inequalities.

value.rationale: A recent primary theorem proves a square-root excess for uniform binary multiword LCS; fixed strict bias is an equally natural source regime in LCS and sequence comparison. The new theorem gives an explicit, substantively smaller (log d)/d excess bound for every such law and a finite-parameter variational envelope. It distinguishes a qualitative probabilistic phase, not an arbitrary small case or numerical table; matching lower rate is openly left unproved.
